name: Living Goods
summary: Equips and supports community health workers in Kenya, Uganda and Burkina Faso, with governments, to treat sick children at home for malaria, pneumonia and diarrhoea, register and follow pregnancies and provide family planning.

spending.source: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/205010527 (Living Goods, Form 990 for 2024, Part IX line 25 column B: program service expenses 21,325,882 of 25,995,769 total, including 17,531,723 of grants to its organisations abroad. Part III: 9,996 community health workers in Burkina Faso, Uganda and Kenya, 1,540,361 children assessed and treated.)

lines.label: Support to community health workers (child treatment, pregnancy care, family planning)
lines.source: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/205010527 (Form 990 for 2024, Part III line 4a: one programme, 21,325,882)
